description: Utility service request emitted by the infra-utility-connect service_request Pregel cell. One record per utility class (water / gas / electric / telecom); a building site typically generates 4 records. Carries the parent tatekata mepSignoffRecord CID + site coords + the provider RPC trace (G1 open-source). Per ADR-2605250900 + gates G1 (open-source RPC), G2 (IPFS-pinned provider responses), G5 (Charter Rider §2(e) — no commercial utility-broker middleware, members request directly to the provider).

serviceRequestId.description: Stable identifier; prefixed with utilityClass for human readability (e.g. `water:<ticket>`).

utilityClass.description: Schema rejects unsupported utility classes. R0 covers the 4 fundamental civilian utilities only.

providerReference.description: Opaque jurisdiction-recognized provider identifier (e.g. utility-company DID or registered ID number). Free-text provider names disallowed — must resolve to a recognized provider entity.

mepSignoffRecordCid.description: IPFS CID of the parent tatekata MEP-phase sign-off record. Establishes that the construction reached the MEP commissioning gate before utilities are requested.

providerRpcAttestationCid.description: G1: IPFS CID of the open-source RPC trace (request payload + provider response) used to submit. No commercial broker middleware (G5).
